failure_policy: Preserve failed phase and exact error/cost receipts; stop dependent work. No toy graph,subset,fallback backbone,loop fix,AMP,chunking,epsilon search,hidden config/seed or retry to erase failure. A changed implementation needs a new source-only version/admission.

gates.name: Source binding and lineage
gates.require: Metadata checker passes; saved source SHA256/Git blobs match; all R17 manifest payload hashes match. No model/provider imports or compilation in this gate.

gates.name: Role and label custody
gates.require: Actual isolated custodian/worker namespaces and deny-path audit before target read/output; archive identity reverified under later admission; public roles frozen first; source packs bind exact role/policy/archive hashes. Test remains CLOSED.

gates.name: Public preprocessing and graph contract
gates.require: Full public row/edge axis; binary labels known two classes; source-role target/missingness parity; typed feature casts,constant drop,binary-fraction move,transductive fit scopes and order match pinned source. Remove loops,to_simple,to_bidirected; do not add loops. Reject raw GraphDataset/GraphTask/all-label metrics.

gates.name: Environment and resource feasibility
gates.require: Fresh exact runtime fingerprint and qualification for Python3.12.9,Torch2.4.0,DGL2.4.0,sklearn1.6.1 plus actual dependency closure; no use of R17 certificate. Full admitted graph float32 native and K4 forward/backward,JVP/VJP,initializer peak memory and latency measured. Deterministic algorithms and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; stop on unsupported nondeterministic primitive or OOM. Author A10080GB is context, not a local requirement/forecast.

gates.name: Cold native and Torch COO parity
gates.require: Disposable full-graph exact native DGL vs K1/K4 identity logits,bias placement,named gradients. Same eid-order endpoints and exact [N,128,4] channel layout. Populated-history donor AdamW one-step native-vs-family and DGL-vs-COO parity with dropout off and every R/S frozen; compare parameters,scaled moments,scalar steps,group options and logits. Native closed validation-AP calculation must match pinned provider on compact validation data. No useful qualification checkpoint retained.

gates.name: Complete bounded native grid
gates.require: Exactly c0/c1/c2 × seeds17/29/43 registered before fitting; all nine terminal receipts; no test access. Select max mean best validation AP with fixed config-order ties. Every native fit max1000/patience100,no AMP,two-logit CE.

gates.name: Source-validation competence screen
gates.require: For selected config, all three best validation AP exceed constant-probability validation AP and their mean uplift is at least0.05 AP units. Both source roles have two classes; finite nonconstant predictions; no collapse or missing warm50 donors. Use one fixed train-derived constant probability; AP uses source-validation labels. Failure stops extension; no test-guided rescue. Passing is only a prespecified basic learning screen, not external competitiveness or published score reproduction.

gates.name: Actual warm qualification
gates.require: At each selected-config seed warm50 donor: repeat identity,bias,gradient,AdamW populated-history one-step checks; then K1 Torch COO factor-slice JVP/VJP/central-FD checks. Three fixed directions seed+90000; eps1e-3 and3e-4; dual rtol2e-4 and logit and CE FD rtol0.05 for at least one of the two predeclared epsilons per direction (unchanged borrowed rule). Every intended arm must have a linked receipt before initialization, with numerical reuse only for identical frozen donor/input/source identities. No epsilon/seed search.

gates.name: Initializer and continuation custody
gates.require: Frozen selected config,shared fixed_last warm50 state and RNG per seed; train-only factor seeding; all five arms log trial/alpha/fallback receipts. Restore donor RNG after qualification/initialization. Continue at most950 updates with native AP patience100; epoch0 and each update selected by mean-probability class1 validation AP. No validation gradients or initializer inputs; mean member CE training. Keep raw selected logits for secondary pooling; test CLOSED.

gates.name: Strong sharing and cost controls
gates.require: Three paired selected-config four-head single-body controls with same warm50 and max950 continuation; same AP pooling/selection and mean member CE. Reuse three independently fitted selected-config native predictors as ensemble competence reference. Record actual parameters and full-operation memory/latency/cost. K3 vs K4 mismatch is disclosed; exact parameter- or latency-matched extra training requires a separate frozen plan before efficiency utility claims. Shared-head control source must implement and qualify private W/B moment/epsilon scaling at K4,unchanged decoupled decay,and shared-body moment copying before use; current packet supplies the plan,not that control implementation.

gates.name: Final closure and report
gates.require: All attempts terminal and chosen configs/checkpoints/pooling/control identities/costs frozen with hashes before separate final label admission. Once-only final test report; no selection/retraining. Contemporary separately costed GraphPFN FT and LightGBM+NFA qualification is required before broad competitive claims.
